status: All 60 findings implemented and deployed to testnet; qualification scope and remaining limits recorded in evidence.

findings.title: Posting is step 3 of a withdrawal wizard
findings.change: End onboarding when posting becomes available. Make the board and composer the home screen; put “Get deposit back” in Account.

findings.title: Infrastructure copy precedes the actual task
findings.change: Lead with board identity, messages and one primary action. Show a short explicit testnet notice; put explanations at the decision they affect.

findings.title: The interface is a transaction log
findings.change: Render concise operation stages from application data. Put safe diagnostics in a collapsed Details panel with a copy action. Never parse logs to drive UI state.

findings.title: No consistent navigation or board identity
findings.change: Use a shared header with board name, Read, Write and Account. Keep operator tools in a separate area. Preserve verified board/network identity across links.

findings.title: Withdrawal warnings occupy the writing screen
findings.change: Show posting readiness beside the composer. Show withdrawal preparation only when requesting the deposit back. Expose moderation rules as readable board information.

findings.title: There is no log out or switch account action
findings.change: Add explicit Lock account and Switch wallet actions through the account API. Preserve pending-operation records and safely handle active work before switching.

findings.title: A returning user can be steered into a new passkey
findings.change: Offer Use existing account and Create account at the right point in connection. Do not infer a new person from missing local storage.

findings.title: Connected and ready are conflated
findings.change: Separate wallet connection, private-account unlock and board readiness. Retry setup with the loaded wallet; preserve the meaningful failure.

findings.title: Recovery instructions point to a hard-to-reach screen
findings.change: Create persistent Activity access and contextual recovery actions on the affected operation. Remove navigation loops.

findings.title: Everyone is shown three technical recovery buttons
findings.change: Check relevant pending operations automatically. Present “Finish setting up”, “Check message” or “Check withdrawal” only when needed. Keep low-level tools in diagnostics.

findings.title: Passkey recovery and payment recovery are not the same
findings.change: Make the recovery guarantee explicit and address missing payment recovery in the custody design. Offer an integrated backup flow when necessary; do not rely on remembering repeated manual exports.
findings.qualification: New deposits recover from the same private account and Ethereum wallet using canonical nonce-bound derivation. Older random-secret deposits require their original recovery material.

findings.title: Account menu is a recovery-file form
findings.change: Show wallet name/address, private-account status, balances and session controls first. Use separate Restore and Backup tasks with action-specific password fields.

findings.title: Backup validation becomes a generic failure
findings.change: Show the exact safe field error next to its input; distinguish wrong password, invalid file, account already open and storage failure.

findings.title: Current identity is separated from its controls
findings.change: Put a compact wallet label and shortened address in the semantic header, with full verified identities and copy actions inside Account.

findings.title: Deposit is not a comprehensible payment decision
findings.change: Before payment, show refundable deposit, AZTEC fee funding, estimated Ethereum gas and expected wallet confirmations. Distinguish funding credit from fees actually spent.
findings.qualification: Numeric gas estimate covers the ETH deposit component. Approval and AZTEC funding gas are disclosed by the wallet at approval; the interface explicitly does not present the deposit estimate as the combined total.

findings.title: The deposit slider lacks a concise decision summary
findings.change: Keep the requested slider. Present “Deposit X ETH · roughly one post every Y” and the actual board limits; explain burst allowance and penalties under Board rules.

findings.title: Funding and bridge waits look stalled
findings.change: Use named phases with completed steps, elapsed time, approval prompts and known waiting reasons. Use measured estimates only where supported; never fake percentages.

findings.title: Expected bridge delay becomes an error/retry task
findings.change: Keep the durable operation in a waiting state; continue safe readiness checks while open and resume after reopening. Offer a deliberate pause without re-sending the payment.

findings.title: Useful balances are missing from the main account view
findings.change: Show these as three distinct concepts, with sensible precision and transaction details available on demand.

findings.title: The separate fee page retains manual bridge accounting
findings.change: Make Add transaction funds an integrated account task using the same funding coordinator and progress model, with credited balance on completion. Keep hash entry out of ordinary use.
findings.qualification: Fee engine owns its read-only PXE lifetime. Top-up coordinator retains ownership through the balance refresh; the view receives a plain balance result.

findings.title: Fee controls are available without relevant state
findings.change: Derive availability from actual funding state and show the reason where useful. Do not present impossible actions as valid choices.

findings.title: Fee amounts have machine precision and no useful recommendation
findings.change: Show rounded readable amounts with exact values in details, a recommended top-up and its purpose. Do not imply a guaranteed number of posts from a variable network fee.

findings.title: Default remote proving lacks a visible explanation
findings.change: Keep the single toggle. State visibly that private transaction information is shared with the configured prover operator, identify that operator, and provide fuller details accessibly.

findings.title: The proving toggle is visually broken
findings.change: Use a compact, properly aligned checkbox or switch with a complete clickable label and normal keyboard behavior.

findings.title: Proving choice does not clearly communicate current work
findings.change: Keep operation configuration immutable. Show the active operation’s mode in its progress; make “applies to the next transaction” visible when relevant.

findings.title: Prover failures prescribe generic retries or reloads
findings.change: Return safe typed service statuses through the API. Offer Retry or Use this device only when valid for the saved operation; never silently change trust modes.
findings.qualification: Live Spot interruption produced the specific prover-unavailable state while retaining the confirmed payment. Recovery qualification is recorded separately.

findings.title: Ready is described as expiration
findings.change: Use “Ready to post” or “You can post again in …”, driven by verified chain state. Do not claim readiness solely from a local clock.

findings.title: Screening is an unexplained author chore
findings.change: Remove it from normal composing. Orchestrate necessary screening inside an explicitly authorized withdrawal workflow, preserving moderation windows, verified eligibility and fee limits, and explaining fees and required approvals.

findings.title: Message validation can produce a wallet error
findings.change: Show a live capacity indicator and inline validation, preserve text, and prevent an invalid submission. Keep technical byte detail secondary.

findings.title: No explicit draft lifecycle
findings.change: Define safe draft preservation scoped to board/account, with deliberate privacy/retention behavior. Preserve failed drafts and never silently publish a restored draft.

findings.title: Success is a pile of confirmations rather than a clear result
findings.change: Show one “Posted” confirmation, link/highlight the published message, and keep the composer available for the next post. Put fee/receipt detail under Activity.

findings.title: Public reading and logged-in reading are inconsistent
findings.change: Share one feed presentation and navigation model while keeping public reading independent of wallet initialization.

findings.title: Messages lack ordinary context and stable sharing affordances
findings.change: Show readable time, a stable per-message link and status where relevant. Keep chain IDs and transaction hashes in details.

findings.title: The public reader omits the board rules
findings.change: Expose the same readable Board rules from both views, before someone pays to participate.

findings.title: New messages require manual refresh in the public reader
findings.change: Use an explicit new-message update affordance or gentle refresh that preserves reading position. Load history as history with bounded progress and a clear Older messages action.

findings.title: Reading status dominates useful content
findings.change: Use a compact navigation row, a proper Copy board link action and a quiet sync status only when useful. Give content the strongest hierarchy.

findings.title: Four indistinguishable boards are listed by address
findings.change: Add operator-provided names/descriptions tied to verified addresses, recent activity and availability. Identify the current test board and clearly mark retired operator deployments.

findings.title: Discovery makes the user operate a chain scan
findings.change: Show usable results early, continue bounded discovery, and provide meaningful loading/empty/retry states. Keep scan position in diagnostics.

findings.title: Bad links and temporary outages share a useless retry
findings.change: Distinguish invalid link, unsupported network, unavailable board and temporary connection problems. Offer Browse boards or Retry as appropriate.

findings.title: Unavailable posting silently disappears
findings.change: Keep a clear reading-only state and a short explanation of unavailable posting. Avoid showing a working board as an unexplained missing button.

findings.title: Withdrawal is exposed as two blockchain tasks
findings.change: Present one Get deposit back journey with requested, waiting, ready for wallet confirmation and received states. Required wallet signatures remain explicit.
findings.qualification: Settlement orchestration and pause are tested at the application/engine boundary. No new real withdrawal settlement was run for this UX change.

findings.title: Eligibility gives chores rather than a plan
findings.change: Show the refundable amount, why it is waiting, the next eligible time when known and any preparation/fee steps. Prepare through application APIs within the user’s authorized fee limits; preserve moderation windows and verify eligibility before each action.

findings.title: Normal settlement is presented as ERROR
findings.change: Render an ordinary waiting state, check readiness automatically and only request the final Ethereum action when available. Persist progress across sessions.

findings.title: Final withdrawal has no completed screen
findings.change: Show amount received, destination, receipt and Return to board. Derive available actions from completed state rather than restoring the old button blindly.
findings.qualification: Normal, paused/resumed and canonically recovered refunds share the completion presentation; only a matched saved L2 withdrawal can yield refund details.

findings.title: Moderator navigation can change boards
findings.change: Generate every link from the verified current context and retain a return path. Add cross-board navigation tests.

findings.title: A moderator manually types a post number
findings.change: Put Moderate on the actual message. Review the message, reason and concrete penalty before submission; validate integer identifiers strictly.

findings.title: Authority transfer has no clear consequence review
findings.change: Use a dedicated transfer review with the full validated address, operator confirmation of the destination, and a loss-of-authority explanation before the final action.

findings.title: Immoral/censor/K language obscures board rules
findings.change: Use Moderator and Hide for rule violation. Show the rule, reason and actual posting-delay effect; retain contract terminology only in diagnostics.

findings.title: Configuration overwhelms the moderator entry point
findings.change: Lead with Select board and Unlock moderator account. Accept a board link/config file; put raw JSON and infrastructure settings behind Advanced. Correct empty/saved states.

findings.title: Policy editing lacks a clear review of what changes
findings.change: Edit from the current policy, show a change review and a live indicator of the actual UTF-8 byte limit, and provide precise field errors. Clearly state when the new rules apply.

findings.title: Board creation is a raw operator form
findings.change: Separate Create board from advanced configuration. Show readable settings, validation and actual loading progress, with technical files available for operators who need them.

findings.title: Creation success does not reliably lead to a usable posting board
findings.change: Use a deployment checklist with saved Resume state. Completion must show verified reading/posting/prover/moderator availability and route to what actually works.
findings.qualification: Completion distinguishes contract deployment, verified reading and checked posting configuration. It does not claim a newly deployed board has passed a real posting transaction.

findings.title: Safe validation errors are destroyed globally
findings.change: Use typed user-actionable errors with field/reason/action data through existing interfaces. Keep unexpected diagnostics sanitized without hiding the real next step.

findings.title: Status, cancellation, waiting and failure are conflated
findings.change: Define a consistent vocabulary: waiting for you, working, waiting for network, complete, cancelled and failed. Every actionable failure must offer the applicable action and say what was already completed.

findings.title: Important text has poor contrast
findings.change: Use explicit light/dark color tokens and verify contrast for text, links, warnings, disabled controls and focus states. Do not solve this by recoloring one sentence.

findings.title: Visual hierarchy makes routine actions look equally urgent
findings.change: Define primary/secondary/destructive actions consistently; use normal body typography for prose, generous reading rhythm, compact metadata and a single clear page flow.

findings.title: Visual and keyboard order do not agree
findings.change: Use a semantic header with matching DOM order. Announce concise phase changes, make diagnostics non-live, preserve focus and label actionable readiness updates.

findings.title: Motion and responsive behavior lack complete qualification
findings.change: Respect reduced motion and test real 390px layouts, zoom, keyboard and screen-reader flows. Check floating Account, long addresses, control wrapping and touch explanations.
findings.qualification: 390px layouts, light/dark contrast, keyboard traversal, reduced-motion styles, actual 200% Chromium zoom and native accessibility-tree roles/names passed. Human screen-reader testing remains unverified.

findings.title: Loading and unavailable states expose the wrong affordances
findings.change: Render a coherent loading state with a meaningful status. Enable normal actions only when their prerequisites exist and show a useful Retry on failure.

findings.title: There is no concise support handoff
findings.change: Provide Copy diagnostic report containing safe operation ID, stage and error code, excluding keys, claim secrets and private witnesses. The app retains transaction accounting.
